# cravingmaker/skills

One owned collection of [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io/specification) for planning, building, reviewing, and shipping work. Each capability handles one job; `agent-orchestrator` coordinates work that needs several agents.

Install the skills you need with the commands below. The human handbook ([English](handbook/README.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](handbook/id/README.md)) explains how to choose and use them, with [evaluation results](handbook/eval-results.md) from committed records.

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED skill-counts: generated by scripts/build-docs.py; edit the catalog or SKILL.md files, then rerun it -->

**58 skills:** 1 router and 57 capability skills. 24 prefer explicit selection; the agent can pick the other 34 on its own. Evaluation status: 57 evaluated, 1 unevaluated.

<!-- END GENERATED skill-counts -->

## Start using the collection

Clone the repository and preview an installation before applying it:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/cravingmaker/skills.git
cd skills
scripts/install-skills.py --host codex --target ~/.codex/skills clear-communication
scripts/install-skills.py --host codex --target ~/.codex/skills --apply clear-communication
```

Repository tools need uv and Python 3.12 or newer. See [getting started](handbook/getting-started.md) for Claude Code installation, updates, and copy versus symlink choices.

## Contribute

Read the [authoring guide](docs/authoring-guide.md) and [skill procedures](docs/skill-workflows.md), then run the [candidate checks](docs/validating.md). The [changelog](CHANGELOG.md) records merged changes; the handbook explains [how the collection is made](handbook/how-and-why.md).
